item.title: Firearm Arrests, Suicide Attempts, BNT Funding
item.ns0:title: Firearm Arrests, Suicide Attempts, BNT Funding
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, we take you on the crime beat where police are ramping up efforts to get illegal firearms off the streets following a series of high-stakes chases and arrests. We also investigate a "disturbing trend" as authorities respond to a series of heartbreaking suicide attempts involving young girls in the Family Islands. Plus, the Bahamas National Trust sounds the alarm over a critical funding gap threatening our natural treasures, while a local bar makes history as the first in the nation to be named among the best in North America. Join us for these headlines, an update on the closing of National Family Week, and your complete sports and weather report.
